office_name: County Judge + Sheriff + County Clerk + District Clerk + Tax Assessor-Collector
notes: Five countywide elected offices share the Collin County boundary: County Judge Chris Hill; Sheriff Jim Skinner; County Clerk Stacey Kemp; District Clerk Michael Gould; and Tax Assessor-Collector Scott Grigg. All nine scoped current holders are elected incumbents. The County Treasurer office was abolished by the 1984 constitutional amendment and is not a vacancy; the County Clerk Treasury division performs current treasury functions. Census GEOID 48085.
